From plan to delivery

How the work
comes together.

Plan the buying journey

We review your products, payment options, delivery rules and order process, then confirm the features and fixed project quote.

Build the store

We develop the storefront and management tools, set up the required connections and review the experience with sample products.

Check from cart to order

We test browsing, cart, checkout and order handling. Before launch, your team receives guidance on the store features included in the project.

Before we start

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Answers before we get started.

Ask a question →
Can customers pay online or choose cash on delivery?

We can include cash on delivery and suitable online payment options. Availability depends on the platform, your business and provider approval. Account setup and provider fees are discussed separately.

Can you move our existing products and orders?

We first review the available data. The proposal then defines what we can transfer, how it needs to be prepared and which migration checks are included.

Can you build custom store management features?

Yes. Tell us how your team handles products, customers and orders. We review the process and quote for the features that fit your requirements.
